snippets.text: For an authored template, expression or inference transform failure, open the reported node and edit the field named in the message. Item and operation numbers start at one. Correct the field and start a fresh run from the corrected definition. The UI's **New run** uses a published version, so publish the correction before starting it there; to test an unpublished saved draft through the API, use `POST /loops/{id}/runs` with the editable draft's `versionId` and `allowDraft: true`. Resume is unavailable for a deterministic fault in the pinned version. Check the timeline before running again. A heartbeat may already have probed, an earlier context file may already exist, or a child may already have finished. A message saying that GraphGoblin received the provider result means that the reported repair prompt or transform failed afterwards. [Execution and recovery](../05-execution-engine.md#resiliency-model-decided)
